*Auto-generated from CISA KEV, NVD and public advisories; summaries are AI-assisted.*

Three newly added KEV entries are the day's clearest exploitation signal: Drupal Core's installer (CVE-2026-136716, CVSS 9.8) and two OSGeo GeoServer flaws (CVE-2026-120705 XML injection, CVE-2026-129243 authorization bypass), all described as exploitable by unauthenticated attackers. Critical-rated, not-yet-KEV CVEs cluster around virtualization and telephony infrastructure: VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123903) and ESX (CVE-2026-123910, CVE-2026-123911), plus two CVSS 10.0 Mitel OpenScape 4000 flaws (CVE-2026-137721, CVE-2026-137724). Web application and plugin weaknesses also feature heavily, including pulp_python SSRF (CVSS 10.0), Budibase prototype pollution, and WordPress plugins WPMasterToolKit, Product Input Fields for WooCommerce, and FunnelKit Automations.

### Defender priorities

- **Patch KEV-listed Drupal Core and GeoServer first**, and check for exposed instances, including Drupal sites in incomplete installation states.
- **Prioritize VMware vCenter/ESX and Mitel OpenScape 4000 updates**, and limit network access to their management and platform components.
- **Audit and update affected web apps and WordPress plugins** (pulp_python, Budibase, WPMasterToolKit, Product Input Fields for WooCommerce, FunnelKit Automations), checking for unexpected uploads or injected code.

## CISA KEV additions (3)

- **[CVE-2026-136716](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-136716/)** — Drupal Core · CVSS 9.8
  Drupal Core's installer can be reached and abused when a site is in an unusual or incomplete installation state, due to improper handling of exceptional conditions. An unauthenticated remote attacker can take over the site, and exploitation has been observed in the wild.
- **[CVE-2026-120705](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-120705/)** — OSGeo GeoServer
  GeoServer is vulnerable to XML injection via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query, letting an unauthenticated attacker read local text files or make the server fetch attacker-specified HTTP/HTTPS URLs. It can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245 and CVE-2026-129242 for unauthenticated remote code execution, and exploitation has been observed.
- **[CVE-2026-129243](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-129243/)** — OSGeo GeoServer
  GeoServer has an incorrect authorization flaw where a request with a prefixed service parameter bypasses service-level role checks. An unauthenticated remote attacker can invoke operations protected only by those checks, and it is chainable with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245 and CVE-2026-129242 for remote code execution; exploitation has been observed.

## New critical CVEs (15)

- **[CVE-2026-126984](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-126984/)** — Pulp pulp_python · CVSS 10.0
  A server-side request forgery flaw in pulp_python's pull-through caching lets a network attacker supply the redirect query parameter as the URL the content app fetches and returns. This can expose internal resources reachable from the server, and the description suggests it may also involve the remote's credentials (the data is truncated).
- **[CVE-2026-137721](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-137721/)** — Mitel OpenScape 4000 · CVSS 10.0
  The Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager has a command injection flaw caused by insufficient parameter sanitization. An attacker could execute arbitrary commands in the context of the system.
- **[CVE-2026-137724](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-137724/)** — Mitel OpenScape 4000 · CVSS 10.0
  The Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager has improper authentication that lets an unauthenticated attacker gain unauthorized access and obtain sensitive information.
- **[CVE-2026-137498](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-137498/)** — budibase server · CVSS 9.9
  Budibase Server has a prototype pollution flaw where an unauthenticated attacker can supply __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries, erasing MongoDB query filters. This lets a single request read, modify, or delete every document in a collection.
- **[CVE-2026-134963](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-134963/)** — Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit · CVSS 9.9
  The WPMasterToolKit WordPress plugin has a code injection flaw due to improper control of code generation. Successful exploitation could let an attacker run injected code on the site.
- **[CVE-2026-104998](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-104998/)** — tychesoftwares Product Input Fields for WooCommerce · CVSS 9.8
  The Product Input Fields for WooCommerce plugin trusts the client-supplied Content-Type header and keeps the original filename when saving uploads to an unprotected pif_temp directory. This allows arbitrary file upload, which can potentially lead to code execution on the web server.
- **[CVE-2026-123903](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123903/)** — VMware VMware vCenter Server · CVSS 9.8
  VMware vCenter Server has an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service, rated critical (CVSS 9.8). It matters because vCenter controls virtualized infrastructure.
- **[CVE-2026-123910](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123910/)** — VMware VMware ESX · CVSS 9.8
  A heap out-of-bounds write in the ESX I/O filter service has a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8 and is rated Critical by Broadcom. It could compromise the hypervisor and the workloads running on it.
- **[CVE-2026-123911](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-123911/)** — VMware VMware ESX · CVSS 9.8
  A use-after-free in the ESX I/O filter service has a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8 and is rated Critical by Broadcom. It could compromise the hypervisor and the workloads running on it.
- **[CVE-2026-131767](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-131767/)** — Aman FunnelKit Automations · CVSS 9.8
  FunnelKit Automations deserializes untrusted data, which allows PHP object injection. This can let an attacker manipulate application objects and, depending on available code paths, severely compromise the site.
- **[CVE-2026-134481](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-134481/)** — Ultimate Member · CVSS 9.8
  The Ultimate Member WordPress plugin deserializes untrusted data, enabling PHP object injection. Depending on available gadget chains, this can lead to serious compromise of the site.
- **[CVE-2026-106125](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-106125/)** — Sneeit Sneeit Framework · CVSS 9.8
  The Sneeit Framework WordPress plugin exposes an unauthenticated AJAX action that passes an attacker-supplied 'callback' value to call_user_func() after only a function_exists() check, with attacker-controlled arguments. This allows remote code execution without logging in.
- **[CVE-2026-115867](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-115867/)** — crmperks Database for Contact Form 7, WPforms, Elementor forms · CVSS 9.8
  The WordPress plugin's copy_files function lacks file extension validation and accepts attacker-controlled stream wrapper URIs as the source. Unauthenticated attackers can upload files that may be executable, which can compromise the site.
- **[CVE-2026-137738](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-137738/)** — RealVNC RealVNC Viewer · CVSS 9.8
  RealVNC UDP-based connections can be exploited without authentication, potentially allowing remote code execution (as root on some platforms) or a crash. It affects multiple RealVNC viewers, server, and apps.
- **[CVE-2026-135933](/threat-intel/cve/CVE-2026-135933/)** — Tobias WebinarIgnition · CVSS 9.8
  WebinarIgnition has an incorrect privilege assignment flaw that allows privilege escalation. Attackers could gain higher privileges than intended, with a CVSS score of 9.8.
